This update makes Omarchy start right away and fixes a lot of rough edges, including freezes on NVIDIA graphics.

Omarchy now opens immediately and checks for updates in the background while you use it. When an update is ready, it installs the next time Omarchy starts, or right away with Restart to update in the tray. On NVIDIA graphics, GPU mode no longer freezes when Media Player opens, and Files opens instead of crashing. If the desktop ever stops responding, the launcher offers to restart it, in CPU mode if graphics froze. Omarchy also handles Windows sleep, restart and sign-out cleanly, and notification popups are back.

Volume and mute now stay in sync with Windows, and night light warms the screen from the usual menu and shortcut. There are fixes across the clipboard, file drops, keyboard layouts and the Win key, window placement on multiple monitors, cameras, audio devices, port forwards and moved installations. PowerToys and AutoHotkey can see the Win key while Omarchy runs, and several security fixes tighten what the launcher accepts connections from.
